description: FULL BODY figure of a middle-aged Malaysian man, wearing a plain button-down light blue shirt and dark grey slacks. He has short black hair and a weary, tired appearance. Head to toe view.
FULL BODY anonymous human figure, a featureless charcoal grey silhouette wearing a translucent digital overlay of a sharp business suit with a glowing circuit board pattern on the chest.
FULL BODY human-like figure with a completely blank, smooth white robotic head and no facial features, wearing a dark navy blue professional blazer and black trousers. Head to toe view.
FULL BODY figure of a Malaysian man in his late 30s, wearing a crisp dark blue Royal Malaysia Police uniform with a professional peaked cap, silver badges, and a black duty belt. Head to toe view.
